title: Exploring zingerone 2-thiohydantoins as anticancer agents against breast adenocarcinoma: Cytotoxicity, HSA and DNA binding, molecular docking and ADMET prediction.
authors: Stanic, Petar; Rilak-Simovic, Ana; Virijevic, Katarina; Muskinja, Jovana; Jeremic, Nevena; Janjic, Goran; Smit, Biljana
one_liner_zh: 该研究探索姜酮2-硫代乙内酰脲类化合物的抗癌活性，涉及DNA结合和分子对接，但核心是药物-蛋白/核酸相互作用，非TF-DNA转录结合体系，且方法以常规对接为主，与课题聚焦的TF-DNA互作建模关联较弱。
abstract: This study investigates a series of zingerone 2-thiohydantoins for anticancer activity towards human breast adenocarcinoma and explores possible mechanisms of anticancer action. Cytotoxicity was tested on highly invasive triple negative breast cancer MDA-MB-231 cells and healthy MRC-5 cells. The most active compound 2e exerted a significant cytotoxic effect on breast cancer cells, while exhibiting no measurable toxicity on healthy cells. Fluorescence measurements of interactions with human serum albumin, combined with molecular docking, showed strong binding and transport capabilities, suggesting good bioavailability. Fluorescence and hydrodynamic measurements with DNA displayed lower binding affinity, suggesting that protein targets are responsible for anticancer action. Thorough molecular docking screening on 36 possible breast adenocarcinoma protein targets was performed and results suggest competitive inhibition of DNA methyltrasferase 1 as the mechanism of anticancer action. ADMET analysis predicted favorable physicochemical and pharmacokinetic properties.
abstract_zh: 本研究探讨了一系列姜酮2-硫代乙内酰脲类化合物对人乳腺腺癌的抗癌活性，并探索其可能的抗癌作用机制。细胞毒性实验针对高侵袭性三阴性乳腺癌MDA-MB-231细胞和健康MRC-5细胞进行。最具活性的化合物2e对乳腺癌细胞表现出显著的细胞毒性效应，同时对健康细胞无可测毒性。与人血清白蛋白相互作用的荧光测量，结合分子对接 (molecular docking)，显示其具有强结合和转运能力，提示良好的生物利用度。与DNA的荧光和水动力学测量显示较低的结合亲和力，表明蛋白靶点负责抗癌作用。对36个可能的乳腺腺癌蛋白靶点进行了全面的分子对接筛选，结果表明DNA甲基转移酶1的竞争性抑制是抗癌作用机制。ADMET分析预测了有利的理化性质和药代动力学特性。
